name: sicot
description: Système Intégré de Coopération Internationale et de Traduction - ANAC Gabon

scripts.services:up: docker compose up -d libretranslate translate-service ocr-service
scripts.services:down: docker compose stop libretranslate translate-service ocr-service
scripts.services:restart: docker compose restart libretranslate translate-service ocr-service
scripts.services:logs: docker compose logs -f libretranslate translate-service ocr-service
scripts.services:status: docker compose ps libretranslate translate-service ocr-service
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/server && npm run build --workspace=packages/client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=packages/server && npm run test --workspace=packages/client
